Focused exact valuation check for T_p (p = 2 mod 3)

p=5:  T_p=0
p=11: T_p=322102 = 2 * 11^5
p=17: T_p=11899821517 = 29 * 17^7
p=23: T_p=-1010446643080743 = -561 * 23^9
p=29: T_p=-798145148362709627351 = -65419 * 29^11
p=41: T_p=285608599198466451834837856911313 = 183659513 * 41^15
p=47: T_p=-36201375290118292903477796139763762494 = -1358505762 * 47^17
p=53: T_p=625211553014678241605175931243651758726469297 = 1083391620341 * 53^19

For every nonzero calibrated case:

    v_p(T_p) = (p+4)/3.

The p=23 factorization previously printed as 3*11*17*23^7 for D_b was off by one power: D_b=561*23^8 and T_p=-561*23^9.
